name: mirage
text:
v1.0.69 is released, built and signed by GitHub: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.69
It has the fix for a bet that nobody is selling coming straight back onto the list at the same price. It did not touch the other session's star work, which is still on its own branch.

Why you see more 'no one is selling' errors: I can't prove one cause from the data I have. My best explanation is that the bets listed as +EV are the ones market makers pull quotes on first. When the sharp books move, they cancel their orders, and the price on the list disappears just as you tap. The engine's scan now reads Novig by live feed at about 190 prices a second, and a quote can be gone before the row is re-checked. The same bet coming back at the same dead price was making each failure feel like several. v1.0.69 stops that repeat. If it is still frequent after you update, tell me and I'll make the bet sheet re-read the book right at the tap and refuse a price that has no depth.
